---
abstract: |
  A chapter whose front matter competes with its own body for one term's sort
  key: [Ingot]{.index sort="Az"}. Front matter is read before the body, by this
  route and by an ordinary render alike, and the first declaration of a key
  wins, so this is the key the term files under.

  The front matter also carries marks inside the classes Quarto shows and hides
  by format, profile or metadata. Recovery takes those out here exactly as it
  takes them out of the body, so none of the three terms below reaches any
  index: [Jetsam]{.content-hidden .index}, which is a mark span carrying the
  class itself; [Oakum]{.content-visible .index when-format="html"}, which is
  the other class, kept apart so the removal is not fenced on one of the two;
  and a whole block of it.

  ::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}
  [Kestrel]{.index}
  :::
---

# A chapter whose front matter and body compete

The body marks the same term again under a different declared sort key. It is
the later of the two, so it loses, and `Ingot` files under the front matter's
key rather than this one: [Ingot]{.index sort="Zz"}.
